{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#flux: --job-name=100c100
#flux: --output=/home-mscluster/npather/disentangle/100c100.{{id}}_{{taskid}}.txt
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1

# Note: Slurm --partition directive (stampede) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Queue/partition selection not preserved. Job may run on different hardware.
# Note: Slurm array functionality (--array=0-2) does not have a direct Flux batch equivalent.
# You may need to submit multiple jobs or use flux bulksubmit for array-like behavior.
# Performance consideration: Array task functionality not available. Script will fail without manual adjustment.
# Note: Flux uses {{id}} for job ID and {{taskid}} for array task ID (if supported).

# WARNING: SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID equivalent not available in Flux batch scripts.
# You need to handle array job functionality differently.

python3 main.py \
--aicrowd_challenge=false \
--name=100c100 \
--alg=BetaVAE \
--traverse_z=true \
--traverse_c=true \
--dset_dir=/home-mscluster/npather/disentanglement-pytorch/data/dsprites \
--dset_name=dsprites_full \
--encoder=PadlessGaussianConv64 \
--decoder=SimpleConv64 \
--discriminator=SimpleDiscriminator \
--z_dim=20 \
--use_wandb=true \
--w_kld=1.0 \
--w_tc=9.0 \
--lr_G=0.001 \
--lr_scheduler=ReduceLROnPlateau \
--lr_scheduler_args mode=min factor=0.95 patience=1 min_lr=0.00005 \
--max_iter=90000 \
--iterations_c=90000 \
--max_c=100 \
--evaluat
--evaluation_metric mig sap_score irs dci beta_vae_sklearn factor_vae_metric \
--alg=BetaVAE \
--loss_terms \
--use_bandit=false \
--controlled_capacity_increase=true \
--loss_txt=false \
--wandb_project_name=anneal \
--qma_alpha=0.001 \
--boltzmann_lambda=15
"
}
